context.note:
Follows the recording's status: %1$d is how many times the charger stopped charging, %2$s for how long in all ("12 min").
         English "once" means exactly 1 stop. In a language whose "one" category also covers other
         counts (Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Croatian, Serbian and Bosnian
         "one" covers 21, 31, 41...; Brazilian Portuguese and French "one" covers 0), the "one" item
         must keep %1$d and say the count ("%1$d time"), never a word for once.
